title: Common affine trivialization of two invertible modules
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let M and N be X-modules with typeclass instances SheafOfModules.IsInvertible M and SheafOfModules.IsInvertible N [def-sc-invertible-module], let x be a point of X, and let W be an open containing x. Then there is an affine open U with x in U, U contained in W, a free generator eM of M over U, and a free generator eN of N over U.
